components.name: Default button
components.css: .ds-button{font-family:Segoe UI, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink,#253445);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:32px;padding:5px 12px;border:1px solid #c9d2db;border-radius:4px;background:#fff;font-weight:550;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .12s ease-out,border-color .12s ease-out;}.ds-button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#eff5fa;border-color:#91a9bc}.ds-button:active:not(:disabled){background:#e1edf6}.ds-button:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:default}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#176aa3);outline-offset:2px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}

components.name: Export button
components.description: Primary package action, enabled only when export is ready.
components.html: <button class="ds-export"><svg width="17" height="17" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3v12m-4-4 4 4 4-4M5 16v5h14v-5"/></svg>Export combined PDF</button>
components.css: .ds-export{font-family:Segoe UI, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink,#253445);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:32px;padding:5px 12px;border:1px solid #c9d2db;border-radius:4px;background:#fff;font-weight:550;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .12s ease-out,border-color .12s ease-out;width:100%;min-height:39px;font-size:12px;color:#fff;background:var(--accent,#175a87);border-color:var(--accent,#175a87)}.ds-export:hover:not(:disabled){background:#10466c;border-color:#10466c}.ds-export:active:not(:disabled){background:#e1edf6}.ds-export:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:default}.ds-export:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#176aa3);outline-offset:2px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}

components.name: Text action
components.css: .ds-text{font-family:Segoe UI, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink,#253445);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:32px;padding:5px 12px;border:1px solid #c9d2db;border-radius:4px;background:#fff;font-weight:550;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .12s ease-out,border-color .12s ease-out;min-height:26px;padding:3px 0;font-size:11px;color:var(--accent,#175a87);background:transparent;border:0}.ds-text:hover:not(:disabled){color:#0c3d60;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}.ds-text:active:not(:disabled){background:#e1edf6}.ds-text:disabled{opacity:.48;cursor:default}.ds-text:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#176aa3);outline-offset:2px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}

components.name: Search field
components.description: Labeled drawing search with an inset magnifier.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="6.5"/><path d="m16 16 4 4"/></svg><input aria-label="Search drawings" type="search" placeholder="Search number or title"></label>
components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;position:relative}.ds-search svg{position:absolute;left:10px;width:16px;height:16px;stroke:#627487;stroke-width:1.6;pointer-events:none}.ds-search input{font-family:Segoe UI, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink,#253445);width:100%;height:37px;min-width:0;padding:6px 9px 6px 34px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #c9d2db;border-radius:4px;caret-color:var(--accent,#175a87);transition:background-color .12s ease-out,border-color .12s ease-out}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:#687583}.ds-search input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#176aa3);outline-offset:2px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}

components.name: Project file navigation
components.description: Grouped file commands with a structural divider.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}.ds-nav button{font-family:Segoe UI, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink,#253445);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:32px;padding:5px 12px;border:1px solid #c9d2db;border-radius:4px;background:#fff;font-weight:550;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color .12s ease-out,border-color .12s ease-out;min-height:33px}.ds-nav span{height:22px;width:1px;background:var(--line,#d9e0e6);margin:0 6px}.ds-nav button:hover{background:#eff5fa;border-color:#91a9bc}.ds-nav button:active{background:#e1edf6}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#176aa3);outline-offset:2px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}

components.name: Drawing catalog row
components.description: Distinct inspection and inclusion controls; preview wash marks the inspected sheet.
components.css: .ds-row{font-family:Segoe UI, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink,#253445);display:grid;grid-template-columns:18px minmax(0,1fr);gap:10px;padding:13px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid #e9edf1;background:#eaf3fa;box-shadow:inset 2px 0 var(--accent,#175a87)}.ds-row input{accent-color:var(--accent,#175a87);width:15px;height:15px;margin:2px 0 0;cursor:pointer}.ds-row button{font-family:Segoe UI, Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;font-size:13px;color:var(--ink,#253445);display:block;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;padding:0;text-align:left;width:100%;font-weight:400;line-height:1.45;cursor:pointer}.ds-row-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:4px}.ds-row-top strong{color:#234860;font-size:13px;font-weight:650}.ds-row-top>span{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted,#5e6c7c);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-row-title{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#465565;line-height:1.5}.ds-row button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#176aa3);outline-offset:2px}.ds-row input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#176aa3);outline-offset:2px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{transition:none!important}}

components.name: Panel container
components.description: Flat workspace panel with a compact heading and numerical count.

narrative.overview:
A compact, light engineering workspace makes the original drawing the visual focus. Restrained blue identifies actions and state; neutral panels, fine dividers, and familiar file controls support repeated use. Bluebeam Revu and Windows File Explorer are familiarity references, without copied branding.

The interface uses practical density and quiet typography rather than promotional imagery. Catalog selection, drawing inspection, and explicit package order remain visually distinct. The desktop workspace is the primary operating context; narrow screens retain the same sequence as stacked panels.
keyCharacteristics: Original drawing as the visual focus
Visible keyboard focus and explicit order

rules.name: The Drawing First Rule
rules.body: Interface color must support navigation and state while leaving the original drawing as the visual focus.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Keep routine controls and panels flat; depth belongs to the original sheet and modal help.

dos: Do keep the original drawing visually dominant and free of added markings.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus on every interactive control.
Do distinguish the previewed row from the checkbox inclusion state.
Do keep export order visible through numbered package rows and explicit reorder controls.
donts: Don't introduce marketing illustrations, promotional hero sections, or decorative gradients into the workspace.
Don't copy Bluebeam or File Explorer branding.
Don't replace the compact rows with ornamental cards or large display typography.
Don't use color alone to communicate inclusion, ordering, or review requirements.
